Phase 74b impl (small fix, no plan cycle, per the arbiter's rule for fixes that are already implemented). The cause, the evidence and the fix are in docs/phases/owed-start-participant-guard.md.

Defect: in full-roadmap mode, after an impl approval, watcher._try_roadmap_advance writes {phase: next, type: plan, turn: lead, status: ready} with no cycle yet. participants.check_participants found no record for that target. Because the status was ready, it called compare((None, None)), which raised ParticipantMismatch. That blocked both the watcher's lead dispatch and the lead's cycle init (the proposed= path also goes through the state target). Observed on Liminal, 3.14.9: watcher-events.jsonl has kind=refused at 2026-09-25T05:46:36Z and 06:01:48Z (pid 13833), right after the AUTO-ADVANCE to said-it-before. The run continued only after a restart on this tree.

Change (f22b2f7):
- tagteam/participants.py: _owed_start(state, phase, kind) returns true only when all of these hold: turn=lead, status=ready, run_mode=full-roadmap; kind=plan and it is the state's target; roadmap.queue[current_index] == phase. check_participants skips the comparison only in that case. Every other cycle-less state is still refused, and cycle init still compares proposed names against the configuration.
- tests/test_participants.py: +10 cases.
  - Two drive the real _try_roadmap_advance: dispatch passes, and init_cycle records claude/codex.
  - One refuses a mismatched proposed pair at the boundary.
  - Seven near-miss states stay refused: reviewer turn, working, impl, single-phase, wrong queue entry, out-of-range index, no roadmap.
- The single-phase plan→impl advance is untouched. It keeps the state on the approved plan cycle, which exists.

Verified: tests/test_participants.py gives 25 passed. The full suite is this submission's gate run. Also committed on the branch: docs/tagteam-issue-roadmap-slug-and-cockpit-state-line-2026-09-24.md (fb0b0db), a separate Liminal report, docs only; out of scope for this fix.

GATE: PASS | scope skipped | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2621 passed, 5 skipped, 8m44s)

Approved. Reviewed f22b2f7 at HEAD fb0b0db against the phase document and the actual watcher advancement, dispatch, and cycle-init paths. The missing-cycle exception matches the full-roadmap lead-ready plan start and is reached only when no cycle record exists; existing unfinished-cycle identity checks and proposed participant validation remain intact. The new tests exercise the real roadmap transition, successful init, mismatched proposed names, and seven near-miss states. Focused verification: tests/test_participants.py — 25 passed; git diff --check clean. Accepted the recorded gate result at HEAD fb0b0db (2621 passed, 5 skipped); did not repeat the full suite. The gate skipped scope because this fix has no plan-cycle boundary; manually verified the implementation diff. The separate Liminal issue report is documentation only. No interjections or advisory standing orders applied.
